summary: Implemented exhaustive global meeting/room/time assignment optimization with DST fold handling, directed consecutive-person transitions, blocks, requirements, and deterministic tie-breaking.
tests_run: node public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs via provided test runner: 4 passed, 0 failed
limitations: Exhaustive search is exponential in the number of meeting/room/time alternatives, though bounded input size is at most 10 meetings and 3 rooms.
Uses Node Intl time-zone data for the specified zones and supported date range.
